scope: Input-only and external diagnosis of missed ball-out stoppages for the restart-dead default. DFL J03WMX/J03WN1/J03WOH/J03WOY (consumed), Metrica Sample Games 1-3 tagged scenario, challenge BAR-ATH inputs only (no labels, no public-window scores, no video).
dfl_shallow_exit_explanation: DFL freezes the ball at the crossing point (95-100% frozen frames in outside episodes); every outside episode of at least 1 s is dead, every shorter one live. This is a provider encoding convention.
challenge_outside_episodes: Challenge ball tracking never freezes; only 3-5 observed outside episodes are shallower than 1 m and last at least 1 s, so relaxing the 1 m exit margin would mainly fit the DFL convention.
finding: Short throw-in stoppages match the Metrica dead-ball convention that defines challenge truth (truth p10 0-0.7 s), so lengthening them is not justified. The DFL exit headroom is dominated by a DFL-specific frozen-ball convention and does not transfer.
decision: No exit-stoppage change; working default unchanged.
